steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The Infected are making their move.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: They'll really charge through the front door?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: They'd better. The bigger their ruckus, the less we leave the Board to use against us.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: How are things at the power plant?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are you doubting me?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Can I kill Wild Mane?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Of course... now that things have come to this.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If we find ourselves some prey, that'll help make our owners less grumpy.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: They're prey who got away to begin with... I'm just taking back what should've been mine.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Contact Team 3. Have them pack it up and come with me.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Wild Mane spotted! Wild—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Too slow, Armorless!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Pulling dirty tricks in the shadows... Don't tell me you people have forgotten how to take on a knight!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Filthy Infected!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: This is for Jamie and all the innocent who died by your hands!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Eek—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —Iwona! Don't forget what Sona said. Avoid killing anyone if you can... At the very least, when you kill them, make sure you're prepared to handle it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, you. Armorless... How many people have you killed?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Heh...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Trying to act all righteous now, are we? Hypocritical brat. Back when I was a bounty hunter on the Golden Prairie, I never gave a crap about that!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Have you forgotten what life outside the cities is like? Those who stand at the top, the strongest survivors, are all cold-blooded bastards! That's the way it goes!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Say whatever you want, but I've won.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: When you've lost, when you're dead, nothing you say matters.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: He probably sent out a distress signal just now...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hopefully that'll lure the Armorless Union here. That'll make Greynuty's job easier.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Fartooth, have you spotted any Armorless over there?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Greynuty's already in position. Just waiting on our signal.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: That said, the Armorless can't be this slow to react... Did Wild Mane really manage to lure them her way?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She probably...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Armorless spotted. They're heading your way from an alleyway on 4th Street, Iwona!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Iwona...? Can you hear me? Iwona?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Hey?! Szewczyk? Iwona?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The transmission... got cut? No way... In a city with this much transmission traffic...?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: This silence is creepy... Iwona. I have a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Are those Armorless guys really such pushovers that we can take them down with an ambush?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm not sure.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Bigger problem, I'm not getting any of Justyna's transmissions, and she should be staring down at us from somewhere up high right—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Shudder)—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Move!
All of a sudden, Iwona is overwhelmed with an aura so suffocating that it threatens to make her puke.
She isn't sure this is really a biological response. It could be some kind of toxin or an Arts effect.
Then, a figure leaps down from the top of a tall tower.
The figure lands on the ground. The landing is silent as the veil lightly covering her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You jumped from so high up, but you didn't even let out a peep, huh?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Must be nice to be a Feline.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Team 3...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: What?! When did they—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (The difference between these guys and the ones we fought just now are night and day... She's wearing blue. Is she the Lazurite from the other day?)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You go on ahead...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: But!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You'd better survive this!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Aargh?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No way. I didn't even see her pull that bowstring—
The Armorless Union operative in blue maintains her one-handed throwing posture.
A hint of dissatisfaction comes through her cold expression. After all, this hunt started on an unlucky note.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: She... threw it?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Aghh! My leg. My leg!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Grit your teeth and keep running! Don't stop!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, stop looking around! I'm right here!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are you Infected all idiots? Look how many bows we have aimed at you.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Wild Mane Knight, you should be dead several days by now. Good on you, though. You still have the chance to play hero today.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Now run. I don't want this hunt to end on a such a boring note. Let's kill some time together.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah, you seem to be mistaken.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Do I look like the kind of gal who hides in the shadows?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You look like the kind who's getting herself killed.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: *Spit*. We Infected are sick of toiling our miserable lives away like that!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're just a bunch of despicable bastards hiding behind the K.G.C.C., doing all kinds of shady business. Every one of us living out in the open is stronger than you!
Remember their faces!
Remember... These knights... These Kazimierzians... These cold-blooded murderers...
Don't let them get away with it!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Armorless scum...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Have you ever fought a gloompincer on the brink of death? Do you know how a dying, cornered animal fights?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You're too full of yourself.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I may die, but that doesn't mean I'll lose. And you. You'll pay your dues right here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Then... My friends will...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Look at you. No fear of death on your face. You don't want to live, yet you still want to win. Ridiculous.
The blue Armorless Union operative takes out an arrow from behind.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're going to use that arrow as a blade? What, you looking down on me?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You little...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Urgh—!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So that's the speed you Kuranta are so proud of?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Don't underestimate me—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hraaagh––!!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Don't be such a crybaby. I made sure not to kill you.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Now let me see how much blood you have to spill.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: After I've painted the entire street with it, the Infected hiding in the dark will probably stop resisting?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Um, Lazurite, she is Infected though...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you're worried about catching it, you should look for a new job.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Once death calms her down, it'll be much easier to deal with the resisting Infected.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's been a while since I heard from Justyna...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Maybe she ran into some kind of trouble?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Either way, there's five minutes till our ambush.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona should be in position by now. We just have to trust each other.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It's almost time...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Everyone, be safe...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You didn't even last a few minutes.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Go on... There should be seven or eight Infected hideouts around here, though I wouldn't be surprised if they're empty by now. Search all of them, one by one.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Get... back... here...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm not... done yet!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'm leaving her to you. Not worth any more of my time.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: All units, prepare to fire—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Didn't I just say... I'm not done?!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: —She still has the strength to fight?!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I don't want to kill too many people here...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The old and the young can go, but I'll take the heads of ten Infected knights back to keep my bosses happy.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... You murderer!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: What did you do to Iwona?!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: She should probably have passed out from the blood loss by now, though it sounds like she might still be putting up a fight.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You monster—!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You should know that even if you manage to get away now, it won't vindicate you.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'll say it again. Ten Infected knights for the lives of everyone else.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: How can we trust you?! You're just a bunch of murderers, a bunch of sick bastards!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'll count Iwona... Just the lives of nine more knights.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are you sure you can win?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Never mind, then... It'll be faster if I do it myself.
Now what's the rush?
If you want to keep your bosses happy, surely you'd want quality over quantity?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Toland Cash.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Not to toot my own horn, but I'm sure I'm worth a hefty sum on the wanted posters?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you are willing to give me your own head, then I won't need any more.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Don't taunt her, Toland! She's—

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: 'Lazurite' Monique of the Armorless Union, am I correct?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I said it before... I don't like to be interrupted when I'm working.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you don't plan on giving yourself up, that makes three times you've interrupted me, Toland Cash.
The injured Infected knight isn't able to see everything clearly.
By the time his eardrums react, there's a sharp clashing sound.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Phew~ You really are quick on the draw with that bowstring.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You saw it...? No, your stance... That's the swordhand of a knight.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Since when do bounty hunters have tricks like that?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh, don't say that. If all we knew was shooting arrows, setting up traps, pulling dirty tricks, and waiting for our prey...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Would we really be any different from the scum in the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You won't dodge many more of my shots.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Whew, that was close.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Might want to watch your step, though.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Nngh—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: An explosive trap...? You're still a bounty hunter in the end...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Needless to say.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: —A charge... You've received knight training?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That's it. You're helping the Nearls... so you must have something tied up with them.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: This really piques my interest, but work is work. We can't waste too much time on you.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Man, what a pain... There's just no catching a taxi during the Major, is there?

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: Excuse me, which way is the Holiday Knight Souvenir Shop?

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: Hey, look at the time. Let's find a restaurant and get a bite to eat first.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Will you look at that?! Our Columbian newbie is about to overwhelm Wisteria Knight once again!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Impressive speed! Now just one more—Hold on, hold on! What's going on?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Unbelievable! A devastating accident at the very last moment! Did our newbie trip?! Come on, this is the Major! Get up!
Do you always leave work this late, Młynar?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: To what do I owe the pleasure...?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If I had known in advance, Lady Russell, I would've received you more properly.

steps.name: Russell
steps.text: Don't worry yourself. I won't be taking up much of your time.

steps.name: Russell
steps.text: Tonight will be messy. There will be lots for us to take care of.

steps.name: Russell
steps.text: Młynar, is the sword-bearing wanderer back?

steps.name: Russell
steps.text: The wanderer traveled through corpse-laden battlefields and boundless wastelands, at last making it to the fortress lit ablaze by cannonfire. Is the wanderer not back yet?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —I still haven't heard anything from them, but we can't wait any longer.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: In five minutes, we'll begin our ambush and cut off the core power source. The core district, where the General Chamber of Commerce is, will lose all power.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Then, and only then, will Sona have a chance to break inside.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: A big show then, huh? I like it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Our Adeptus 'friends' should have withdrawn the security here, clearing a path for us.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We need to be quick. Get ready—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: W-What's that?! Where was that explosion?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: T-The power supply sector? Why?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Ashlock! Why did you start the operation early?!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No, we haven't started the charge yet—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: —We've been had. Get out of there!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Now sleep, Kawalerielki, my beloved Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Good night.
